`final class FileCache`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.cache` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FileCache.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/cache/FileCache.java)

The cache folder of JOID, split into named areas whose entries expire when they go unused.

## Description

Ask for an area by name with [`FileCacheArea.of`](/reference/resources/filecachearea/#FileCacheArea-factory-of) and keep it in a constant; JOID itself uses the areas `msdf` (font atlases), `video` (copies of the videos it plays), `ffmpeg` (the video natives), `lwjgl` (the LWJGL 2 natives) and, in tests, `snapshot`.

```java fragment
private static final FileCacheArea THUMBNAILS = FileCacheArea.of("thumbnails").retention(Duration.ofDays(7L));
```

Every entry that has not been read for longer than the retention of its area is deleted when JOID starts.
Use the cache for files that you can build again; data that must survive goes in the data folder.

## Method details

<a id="FileCache-method-clean"></a>

### clean

`long clean()` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Deletes the expired entries of every area of the cache folder, and the temporary files older than one day, then returns the number of bytes freed.
JOID runs it on a background thread when it starts and logs what it freed.
